2225-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-4050-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

745-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter with an additional Spirit type as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

240-4359-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

215-4359-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-4359-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1202-3249-4289.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-3249-4289.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1957-4050-6634--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

730-1479-2841-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
730-1479-2841-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2232-7827-7834-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7834-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

215-1115-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-1115-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-1753-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-1753-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-1753-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

6085-6086-6087-7666.easyPrerequisites:
Lure attached to Sentinel.
An opponent controls a creature.
6085-6086-6087-7666.notablePrerequisites: Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
6085-6086-6087-7666.description:
Donate Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

240-803-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-2438.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

765-3177-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
765-3177-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-3263-6737-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {5}, creating a token copy of it.
Barret triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Repeat.
2440-3263-6737-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

3532-5078-5901-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5901-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

147-2510-7300.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
147-2510-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 3.

4681-5170-5686-6559.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-6798-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-6798-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

511-817-4050-5902-6441.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3129-5437-5742-5743.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-4289-5081-5434.description:
Activate Obscuring Aether by paying {1}{G}, turning it face-down as a 2/2 creature.
Activate Obscuring Aether by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {C}{C}.
When Obscuring Aether dies, Yarus' second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down, then turning it face-up.
Repeat.

91-647-1365-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1661-4050-4871-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1367-4428-4628.notablePrerequisites: Kaho does not have summoning sickness.
1367-4428-4628.description:
Activate Kaho by paying {7} and tapping it, casting Nexus of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Kaho.
Kaho enters the battlefield, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and exiling it.
Repeat each turn.
